items.title: Rimodulazioni telefoniche: non cambiare può costare fino a 48 euro in più all'anno
items.summary: I dati dell'Osservatorio Tariffe di Segugio.it
items.content:
Sempre più spesso riceviamo messaggi dai nostri operatori telefonici che ci avvisano di un aumento di prezzo, giustificato con le mutate condizioni di mercato o con la necessità di garantire la migliore qualità di rete. Le rimodulazioni prevedono la possibilità di recedere dal contratto senza costi, ma non tutti sfruttano questa opportunità.

Eppure restare fedeli al proprio operatore dopo una modifica unilaterale può costare all'utente fino a 48 euro all'anno in più. A rivelarlo è l'Osservatorio Tariffe di Segugio.it, che ha analizzato sei recenti rimodulazioni confrontandole con le migliori offerte sul mercato per la rete mobile e fissa.

Gli aumenti rilevati vanno da 0,49 a 3,99 euro al mese, ovvero da 5,88 a 47,88 euro all'anno. Un aggravio che appare ancora più marcato se confrontato non tanto con la tariffa pre-rimodulazione, ma con le offerte più vantaggiose attualmente disponibili.

items.title: Un sistema semplice per rendere "Smart" ogni misuratore di pressione, con ESP32
items.summary: Nessun hacking dell'elettronica: qui si parla di... fotografare uno schermo!
items.content:
C'è del merito a comprarsi un misuratore della pressione smart: ce ne sono tanti sul mercato, il problema è che non sono per niente a buon mercato. Ma se ne avete uno "dumb" e un po' di skill con il fai-da-te, un progetto realizzato recentemente da un appassionato potrebbe fare al caso vostro. Come spesso accade, è incentrato sul microcontroller ESP32 - il colpo di scena è che nello specifico si tratta di un modulo ESP32-CAM, che promette di raggiungere il risultato richiesto senza nemmeno modificare l'elettronica del dispositivo.

Come lascia intendere il nome, ESP32-CAM è sostanzialmente un sistema di computer vision: l'idea è di puntare la videocamera montata sul kit al display LCD del misuratore di pressione, e da lì leggere i risultati. Una volta che i dati sono acquisiti, la strada è completamente in discesa - si possono trasmettere automaticamente tramite Wi-Fi a un'applicazione per il monitoraggio della salute, per esempio, con hosting locale dei dati, che quindi non andranno nemmeno a finire su server esterni.

L'autore del progetto racconta di aver inizialmente provato a estrarre i dati direttamente dai circuiti interni. Dopo aver aperto il dispositivo, ha individuato una scheda con un microcontrollore Epson, un sensore di pressione e i componenti che gestiscono la pompa dell'aria e la valvola; è riuscito a intercettare i dati grezzi del sensore, ma si è presto reso conto che i valori finali della pressione sistolica e diastolica vengono calcolati internamente dal microcontrollore. Anche il tentativo di sviluppare un algoritmo alternativo, con l'assistenza dell'AI, non ha prodotto risultati sufficientemente accurati.

items.title: Two dead after bus crashes in France, officials say
items.summary: One child and one young adult were killed in the crash, local authorities say, with more injured.
items.content:
A young girl and an 18-year-old man have died after a bus crashed in eastern France, local authorities have said.

The bus was travelling between Lyon and Bourg-en-Bresse when it crashed at around 07:00 local time on Friday in the town of Lent.

The bus was carrying 43 passengers, including 15 children, the Bourg-en-Bresse prosecutor's office said. Three people are in a critical condition and at least 13 others have sustained minor injuries.

French President Emmanuel Macron said his thoughts were with the victims, the injured, and their families.

In a post on X, he said the nation stood by their side and thanked the rescue teams involved.

The town's mayor Yves Cristin told French media the bus "left the road and hit a tree in the ditch".

The two people killed have been identified by authorities. However, there have been differing reports as to the age of the girl.

The prosecutor's office said it was "opening an investigation into the incident, on charges of road homicide and aggravated road traffic injuries".

The driver has been taken to hospital after sustaining injuries and has not yet been questioned by police. French Transport Minister Philippe Tabarot said initial tests indicated there were no traces of alcohol or drugs in his blood.

Photos circulating in French media show a blue and white bus tilted in what appears to be a ditch on the roadside. Trees line the side of the road. The front of the bus appears to be heavily damaged.

Local mayor Cristin told BFM TV: "I arrived minutes after the accident and people were in shock.

"The side of the bus was torn off, and clearly, the people who were on that side must have been seriously injured."

Addressing weather conditions at the time of the crash, the mayor told Le Figaro "there was a bit of fog, the road was wet" but there were "no major difficulties".

Speaking to the same paper, Fabrice Pannekoucke, head of the Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes region, said: "At this stage, there are no particular explanations or interpretations that can be given."

Tabarot said the bus did not operate "exclusively on school routes" but that there were "many schoolchildren on board".

French Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu said the accident was tragic, and thanked the firefighters, medical teams and police who attended the scene.

Earlier, French Education Minister Édouard Geffray said it was "always difficult when our children are victims of accidents of this nature".

Emergency services were at the scene and medical helicopters were deployed to take victims with serious injuries to a specialised hospital.

More than 100 firefighters and 50 gendarmes were also at the scene.

The local town hall was opened to provide shelter and coordinate with emergency services, the local mayor said.

items.title: Nuovo Codice della Strada: le associazioni di ciclisti e pedoni chiedono lo stop alla riforma
items.summary: Distanza minima inderogabile di un metro e mezzo dai ciclisti e forte critica alla nuova disciplina sugli attraversamenti pedonali. La rete Rime presenta le sue obiezioni alla Camera.
items.content:
La riforma del Codice della strada finisce al centro di un'accesa polemica promossa dalle organizzazioni della società civile impegnate nella sicurezza stradale. Riunite nella Rete italiana mobilità equa (Rime), 42 associazioni hanno presentato alla Camera dei Deputati una richiesta formale al Governo per sospendere l'iter del provvedimento e riaprirne la discussione. Il centro della contestazione è rappresentato dallo schema del decreto legislativo approvato dal Consiglio dei ministri lo scorso 13 ottobre e allo stato attuale all'esame delle commissioni parlamentari.Le critiche delle associazioni, tra cui il Movimento Diritti dei Pedoni, la FIAB e la Fondazione Lorenzo Guarnieri, evidenziano una profonda divergenza sull'impostazione concettuale del provvedimento. Sulla visione strategica del decreto è intervenuta Francesca Chiodi, presidente del Movimento Diritti dei Pedoni e portavoce di Rime, la quale ha dichiarato:
Stiamo riscrivendo le regole della mobilità italiana partendo dalla domanda sbagliata: come far circolare i veicoli, anziché come far muovere le persone.
Secondo quanto dichiarato dalle associazioni coinvolte, le nuove norme - se approvate integralmente - darebbero priorità alla libera circolazione dei veicoli e delle merci, subordinando ad essa la tutela della salute, dell'ambiente e della sicurezza.

Contestate le nuove regole per i pedoni

Uno dei punti maggiormente dibattuti è la nuova disciplina degli attraversamenti pedonali, che imporrà (ricordiamo che attualmente non è in vigore) a chi si trova sulle strisce di accertarsi preventivamente di essere stato visto dal conducente prima di impegnare la carreggiata. Le associazioni sottolineano come tale norma trasformi un diritto in una concessione, risultando di difficile applicazione per bambini, anziani e persone con disabilità.

Distanza inderogabile di 1,5 metri dai ciclisti

Per quanto concerne i ciclisti, viene contestato il sorpasso degli stessi con distanza minima di un metro e mezzo vincolata alla clausola "ove possibile". Le associazioni chiedono invece che il rispetto della distanza diventi un obbligo assoluto ed inderogabile, indipendentemente dalla tipologia della strada e dalle condizioni di traffico.

Limite 30 km/h in città

Per quanto riguarda la velocità massima, Rime richiede l'adozione dei 30 km/h come limite ordinario nelle strade urbane, criticando i nuovi ostacoli burocratici posti ai Comuni. A sostegno della prevenzione si è espresso Stefano Guarnieri, presidente della Fondazione Lorenzo Guarnieri, che ha affermato:
Ogni morte sulla strada è una sconfitta della prevenzione, non una fatalità inevitabile.

Gli altri punti

La rete contesta inoltre l'allentamento delle sanzioni per gli eccessi di velocità in città e il dimezzamento a 45 giorni dei tempi per la notifica dei verbali. La rete chiede anche che la legge di bilancio stanzi risorse finanziarie adeguate per il trasporto pubblico locale e il piano nazionale per la mobilità ciclistica. Suscita infine forte preoccupazione il ridimensionamento dell'autonomia degli enti locali nella gestione del traffico e delle ZTL. Sul punto è intervenuto Marco Granelli, assessore alle Opere pubbliche del Comune di Milano e componente del tavolo dell'Anci, che ha dichiarato:
Non si può chiedere ai Comuni di garantire la sicurezza delle persone e contemporaneamente togliere loro gli strumenti per farlo.

items.title: Un genitore denuncia: 'Mia figlia esclusa dalla mensa per 12 euro'
items.summary: Diffida al Comune di Taranto: 'Ripristinare subito il servizio o ricorso urgente'
items.content:
Una bambina di nove anni esclusa dalla mensa scolastica per un presunto debito pregresso di circa 12 euro, mai contestato prima alla famiglia. È quanto denunciato dal padre dell'alunna, tramite l'avvocato Fabrizio Del Vecchio, che ha inviato oggi una diffida al Comune di Taranto, chiedendo l'immediata riammissione al servizio e riservandosi, in caso contrario, di ricorrere al giudice.

La vicenda riguarda una bambina che frequenta il plesso di un istituto comprensivo, con orario continuato dalle 8 alle 16. Il 2 novembre scorso il padre sarebbe stato costretto a prelevarla anticipatamente da scuola, dopo che l'istituto aveva segnalato il mancato arrivo del pasto per la piccola, a seguito di una comunicazione degli uffici comunali legata a una presunta morosità dell'anno scolastico precedente.

Secondo quanto riferito nella diffida, il debito non sarebbe mai stato precedentemente richiesto alla famiglia, che avrebbe provveduto a saldarlo se informata. "La mensa scolastica - si legge nell'atto - in particolare nelle scuole a tempo pieno, non è un servizio pubblico a domanda individuale meramente accessorio, bensì un momento essenziale e integrante del percorso formativo, didattico e del diritto all'istruzione costituzionalmente garantito".

La diffida chiede al Comune di ripristinare il servizio entro 24 ore dalla ricezione. "Pur restando fermo il legittimo diritto del Comune di avviare le ordinarie procedure di recupero crediti nei confronti dei genitori - sostiene Del Vecchio - è totalmente illegittimo rivalersi sul minore sospendendo l'erogazione del pasto". In assenza di riscontro, il legale annuncia il ricorso alle competenti sedi giudiziarie, anche per il risarcimento dei danni.

"Vedere una bambina allontanata dalla mensa scolastica e dai compagni di classe, in un'età così particolare, è devastante". È il padre della bambina di nove anni esclusa dal servizio di refezione per un presunto insoluto, prima quantificato in 38,40 euro e poi ridotto a 12,80 euro, a raccontare all'ANSA quanto accaduto. "Siamo rimasti scioccati. Non si nega soltanto il pasto, ma - sostiene - anche il diritto allo studio". L'uomo riferisce di essere stato contattato il 2 novembre dalla scuola, con l'invito a prelevare la figlia alle 13 anziché alle 16.15, orario di uscita previsto. "Da quanto ho capito - spiega - , è un modus operandi degli uffici comunali della scuola. È accaduto anche nei giorni successivi". Dopo l'episodio ha inviato una Pec per chiedere chiarimenti sia all'istituto sia al Comune, ricevendo, sostiene, risposte contraddittorie. "La scuola - osserva il genitore - dice che non è di sua competenza, mentre il Comune riferisce che non è stato comunicato l'elenco dei nominativi e che c'era un insoluto degli anni precedenti". Il padre contesta anche le diverse cifre comunicate e la mancanza di una documentazione chiara: "Ho chiesto l'accesso agli atti perché devono dimostrare da dove deriva quella somma. Prima 38,40 euro, poi 12,80, riportati in uno screenshot senza intestazione. Nessuno si vuole assumere la responsabilità". E aggiunge: "Potevano inviarmi una comunicazione per il pagamento, ma in questi mesi non ho ricevuto nulla. Non puoi dire che se non paghi 12 euro non faccio entrare la bambina a mensa. Questo comportamento è aberrante". "Poi devo tutelare mia figlia. Le ho detto: oggi dobbiamo andare dalla nonna che ha fatto la pasta al forno. A questo siamo arrivati, è una situazione assurda", conclude il genitore.

Xiaomi ha pubblicato un video dove si vede il suo umanoide a grandezza naturale impegnato per un turno intero alla postazione di smistamento dei coperchi laterali della console, nello stabilimento Xiaomi Auto. Secondo l’azienda, il robot opera in modo autonomo e non si limita a ripetere il compito: rileva e corregge le anomalie e si coordina con il sistema della linea di produzione. Nelle immagini lo si vede muovere tra carrelli a guida automatica, scaffali e muletti, in un ambiente che non è certo un set protetto.

Le otto ore sono un dato rilevante, perché la vera sfida per gli umanoidi non è più la dimostrazione di un singolo gesto ma la continuità operativa, senza interventi umani. Mancano però i numeri che ci interessano davvero: tasso di errore, interventi manuali necessari, ritmo rispetto a un operaio. Per Xiaomi resta “un altro passo” verso l’impiego industriale reale, ma non è ancora un impiego.

items.title: New wave of bomb threats hit European airlines
items.summary: No link has been established between the threats against the airlines and those against the media outlets.
items.content:
European airlines have again been hit with a new wave of bomb threats - in the third such incident this week.

On Friday multiple flights to and from Lisbon, Rome, Prague and Sofia were targeted and the threats saw three planes escorted by Hungarian fighter jets, authorities said.

It also saw a number of high-profile media organisations, including Ireland's public broadcaster RTÉ , evacuated after threats were made against them - although there has been no concrete links between the messages against airlines and the broadcasters.

The disruption comes after nearly 30 aircraft and several airports across Europe were impacted by threats earlier this week , in what the UK called a "malicious hoax".

A Ryanair flight scheduled to leave Lisbon for Rome on Friday was targeted with a threat, the airline said, while at least 11 flights were targeted in the Czech Republic and Bulgaria, according to AFP.

France also reported at least four of its flights were targeted by threats, however they all landed safely.

As airlines were dealing with this latest wave of threats, several media outlets, including RTÉ, were evacuated after similar warnings were made against them.

Staff at the Irish Independent newspaper and the Dublin offices of radio stations NewstalkFM and TodayFM, were also advised to leave their buildings and UK broadcaster Sky said it also received a security threat.

In a statement, gardaí (Irish police) said they were "aware of a threat made against media organisations here and in Europe".

While no link has been established between the threats against airlines and media outlets, the Irish government has warned it is a "likely coordinated campaign of disruption".

In a statement, it said: "Hoax threats such as these cause fear, distress and disruption to people going about their daily lives and activities; they achieve no positive purpose whatsoever. It is not known yet who is responsible for these threats, whether it is individuals or a centralised or co-ordinated effort.

Irish Prime Minister Micheál Martin described the situation as "worrying" and added his government's first priority was the safety of the Irish public.

"Yesterday, there appeared to be coordinated efforts to disrupt air travel," he said.

Martin told RTÉ it was not yet known if the threats had come from individuals or if it was a "coordinated attack" but said they were being taken seriously.

Ireland is scheduled to host two high-profile European Union meetings in Dublin next week.

Broadcaster Sky confirmed it had received a security threat, hours after RTÉ had evacuated its building.

The broadcaster, which is owned by Comcast, said in a statement read by a presenter on its news channel that the broadcaster had "carried out a security assessment and reported the matter to the relevant authorities".

"The safety and security of our colleagues is our primary concern, and we are working closely with authorities to ensure our people and operations remain secure."

Friday's disruption comes after the Russian extremist group "Male State", named in this week's hoax bomb threats to Italian airports, denied any link to the false warnings .

Replying to the BBC Russian Service, an account on Telegram - one of several linked to the so-called "Male State" and its founder Vladislav Pozdnyakov - mocked any suggestion the group was involved in emailing the threats.

"What Male State? Where have you seen it? It hasn't existed for many years," the message on the channel reads. "If tomorrow they sign a [threat] letter, say, from Putin, will you then try to reach our president to ask your stupid question?"

Who could be behind hoax bomb threats to European air travel?

items.title: Prevenzione del rischio
items.summary: Un’allerta rossa non significa che ci sarà necessariamente un evento catastrofico, ma segnala la possibilità di una situazione molto critica Leggi
items.content:
Per il 5 novembre il Centro funzionale della Sardegna aveva emesso un’allerta rossa: si temeva il peggio perché temporali molto intensi e persistenti avrebbero potuto provocare piene importanti nei corsi d’acqua della parte orientale dell’isola. Fortunatamente le condizioni meteorologiche sono state leggermente diverse da quelle previste, quanto basta per evitare il peggio.

Lo scirocco, che avrebbe dovuto spingere i temporali verso l’interno, è stato più debole di quanto ipotizzato e i violenti nubifragi, che comunque ci sono stati, si sono scaricati prevalentemente in mare, a pochi chilometri dalla costa. È un esempio di incertezza previsionale in cui anche piccoli scarti possono produrre conseguenze molto diverse.

Qualcuno, non vedendo arrivare la pioggia, avrà forse pensato che le previsioni fossero sbagliate. In realtà, allargando lo sguardo, l’evoluzione meteorologica è stata sostanzialmente quella descritta dai modelli, ma con un piccolo errore di localizzazione. Un’allerta rossa non significa che ci sarà necessariamente un evento catastrofico, ma segnala il rischio di una situazione molto critica, per la quale è necessario adottare le misure di prevenzione contenute nei piani della Protezione civile.

Nel fine settimana e nei prossimi giorni sono attese altre piogge, visto che le correnti atlantiche entreranno più decisamente nel Mediterraneo portando anche un deciso rialzo termico. Le temperature medie settimanali saranno ben superiori alla norma. Le precipitazioni saranno copiose al centro-nord e inferiori alla media in Sicilia e Calabria.

Gradi centigradi in più o in meno rispetto alla media stagionale degli ultimi vent’anni. Elaborazione dati: European centre for medium-range weather forecasts (Ecmwf).

items.title: L'UE contro il feed di TikTok: "Spinge gli utenti in rabbit hole dannosi". Chiesta la modifica dell'algoritmo
items.summary: Per la Commissione Europea il sistema di raccomandazione continuerebbe a proporre contenuti simili anche quando riguardano salute mentale, dimagrimento o immagine corporea ... Leggi tutto
items.content:
Per Bruxelles non basta aggiungere qualche controllo in più: TikTok deve intervenire direttamente sul modo in cui funziona il feed "Per Te". La Commissione Europea ha concluso in via preliminare che il sistema di raccomandazione della piattaforma viola il Digital Services Act (DSA) a causa del cosiddetto "rabbit hole effect", il meccanismo che può intrappolare l'utente in una sequenza sempre più ripetitiva di contenuti simili.

Il problema, secondo la Commissione , nasce dal modo in cui TikTok interpreta il comportamento degli utenti. Guardare ripetutamente un video, soffermarsi più a lungo o mettere "Mi piace" viene utilizzato come segnale di interesse e porta il sistema a raccomandare altri contenuti dello stesso genere.

Il meccanismo diventa particolarmente delicato quando riguarda argomenti come perdita di peso, immagine corporea, tristezza o isolamento. Secondo l'analisi della Commissione, l'esposizione ripetuta potrebbe contribuire a peggiorare ansia, insoddisfazione per il proprio corpo, autostima e disturbi alimentari o condizioni psicologiche già esistenti, con rischi maggiori per minori e adulti vulnerabili.

L'indagine ha riguardato anche il modo in cui TikTok ha valutato il rischio di possibili "rabbit hole" e le misure introdotte per limitarli. Secondo Bruxelles, la piattaforma non avrebbe analizzato in maniera adeguata l'impatto che il proprio algoritmo può avere sul benessere degli utenti. In più, le misure già adottate per diversificare i contenuti suggeriti non sarebbero abbastanza efficaci nel ridurre la ripetizione di video simili.

Ma secondo la Commissione anche gli strumenti messi a disposizione degli utenti vengono giudicati insufficienti, come il tasto "Non mi interessa": indicare di voler vedere meno contenuti di un determinato tipo potrebbe non essere sufficiente a modificare il feed perché l'algoritmo continuerebbe a dare maggiore peso, tra le altre cose, al tempo trascorso a guardare i video.

Nella valutazione preliminare, la Commissione ritiene necessario modificare il design stesso del feed "Per Te" , la sezione su cui la maggior parte degli utenti di TikTok passa la maggioranza del tempo speso nell'app. Tra le possibili soluzioni indicate ci sono un maggiore peso assegnato alle preferenze esplicite dell'utente, la rimozione del tempo di visualizzazione come segnale per raccomandare nuovi contenuti, controlli più accessibili e semplici da utilizzare e verifiche periodiche sul comportamento dell'algoritmo.

" Ogni volta che un utente scorre o mette mi piace a un video su TikTok, l'algoritmo gli propone altri contenuti dello stesso tipo, conducendolo in rabbit hole da cui non è semplice uscire ", ha commentato Henna Virkkunen, vicepresidente esecutiva della Commissione Europea per Sovranità tecnologica, sicurezza e democrazia.

Un portavoce di TikTok ha definito le affermazioni della Commissione "sostanzialmente inesatte", sostenendo che rappresentino in modo distorto sia l'architettura della piattaforma sia l'impegno dell'azienda sulla sicurezza. La società afferma di avere già una lunga esperienza nella protezione della propria community e di mettere a disposizione degli utenti strumenti diretti per controllare il tipo di contenuti visualizzati.

Le attuali conclusioni comunque sono ancora preliminari. TikTok potrà esaminare i documenti raccolti dalla Commissione e presentare una risposta scritta; parallelamente verrà consultato anche il Comitato europeo per i servizi digitali.

Se le contestazioni dovessero essere confermate al termine del procedimento, la Commissione potrebbe adottare una decisione formale di non conformità. La sanzione verrebbe calcolata tenendo conto della natura, della gravità, della durata e della possibile reiterazione della violazione e potrebbe arrivare fino al 6% del fatturato annuo globale di TikTok.

items.content:
Hi HN, I’m Jan. I am co-author of the Agentic Identity Broker (AIB), an MIT-licensed OAuth2 broker in the Zalando Incubator, that lets a user give an AI agent scoped, revocable access to MCP services.

The broker solves three major challenges that are especially relevant in corporate environments: (A) Enable users to delegate workloads to agents without providing the agents all the user’s tokens. (B) Connect fragmented identity and authorization systems. (C) Centralize tool approvals and audit logging.

We built AIB to fill an infrastructure gap in our own agent platform. At this moment in time, IETF working groups are still finalizing standards for agent identity, and vendors are still turning the necessary infrastructure into off-the-shelf products. We needed that infrastructure today.

How it works: the user consents once per agent and service. The broker stores the third-party tokens encrypted. At request time a gateway (e.g. Agentgateway) does RFC 8693 token exchange. Agents never see user tokens and MCP servers only implement tools and don’t need to care about all the OAuth 2.1 plumbing.

AIB is v0.1 and runs in production, bringing together hundreds of our agents with dozens of internal and external MCP servers.

To try it locally: clone the repo, run "just compose-up-detached".

The current features focus on on-behalf-of (OBO) use cases, where human actors delegate to agents. Next we are looking to also support headless agents, where agents are invoked by machines. Intent-based authorization is yet another package on our roadmap. If you’ve built either, or have feedback on the UI/UX, I’d like to hear from you!

items.title: Apple iPhone 20, addio al tasto Azione?
items.summary: A quanto pare iPhone Duo è un apripista in questo senso, non un'eccezione.
items.content:
Pare che il tasto Azione degli iPhone non sia destinato a durare tanto: secondo il leaker di Weibo noto come Instant Digital, Apple avrebbe intenzione di eliminarlo già dalla seconda metà dell'anno prossimo, con gli iPhone del ventennale. È possibile che le sue capacità saranno integrate nel Camera Control: una pressione rapida permetterà di aprire la fotocamera (o scattare una foto se è già aperta), mentre la pressione prolungata farà le veci del tasto Azione. Tuttavia, a oggi quel gesto corrisponde all'esecuzione di Visual Intelligence, quindi i dettagli precisi restano ancora da capire per bene.

L'assenza del tasto Azione si è già notata con iPhone Duo, che tuttavia ha un form factor talmente particolare rispetto agli altri iPhone che passa in un certo senso inosservata (c'è il Camera Control, però). Ma visto questo rumor viene da pensare che la scelta di Apple non fosse dettata dalla mancanza di spazio interno, dalla necessità di ridurre i costi o chissà che altra ipotesi circostanziale: potrebbe essere proprio una scelta voluta, l'inizio di un cambiamento a più ampio raggio.

È opportuno osservare che il tasto Azione non ha ricevuto particolari aggiornamenti sostanziali dal debutto. La sua configurazione permette di associare una singola operazione oppure, attraverso l'app Comandi Rapidi, una sequenza di azioni. Tuttavia, una pressione singola non attiva direttamente la funzione: mostra soltanto un avviso che invita a tenere premuto il pulsante. Inoltre, molte delle sue capacità possono già essere replicate aggiungendo un comando rapido alla schermata di blocco. Per contro, è vero che neanche il vecchio slider della suoneria ha mai ricevuto grossi aggiornamenti - Il punto è che certe volte, molto semplicemente, non ce n'è bisogno.

items.title: FAA Begins Retiring Decades Old Floppy Disks from Air Traffic Control
items.summary: Article URL: https://www.faa.gov/newsroom/trumps-transportation-secretary-sean-p-duffy-begins-retiring-decades-old-floppy-disks-air Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50393183 Points: 71 # Comments: 42
items.content:
WASHINGTON, D.C. - U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean P. Duffy today announced the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) is continuing its historic modernization of America’s air traffic control system by replacing outdated floppy disks that contain vital weather and other critical information with a streamlined, 21st-century system.

The Enterprise – Information Display System (E-IDS) replaces four systems dating back to the 1980s that are in more than 400 FAA facilities. E-IDS provides a single, secure system that gives air traffic controllers faster access to information they need. It also will reduce costly repairs and workarounds while enhancing safety for the American flying public.

The first five facilities to receive these upgrades include:

The FAA plans to install E-IDS in 435 sites by the end of 2028.

“Good news America: floppy disks are out, 21st century tech is in,” said U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean P. Duffy . “The greatest nation in the world deserves a state-of-the-art air traffic control system, and under President Trump, we’re delivering just that. The installation of E-IDS is just the latest signal that America’s brand new air traffic control system is coming at lightning speed.”

“E-IDS gives air traffic controllers the information they need to make timely decisions and keep the flying public safe,” said FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford . “We’re moving away from outdated, manual processes and replacing technology that once relied on floppy disks with a modern system that allows controllers to instantly share critical flight alerts, restricted airspace schedules and pilot reports across the National Airspace System.”

You can track the progress of the Brand New Air Traffic Control System (BNATCS) by state and airport on our Modern Skies website .

E-IDS is a digital display board that puts important operational information in one place so controllers can quickly see updates, status information, and alerts they need to keep air traffic moving safely and efficiently. This information includes notices about equipment issues and disruptions, air traffic conditions, weather impacts, and important advisories.

E-IDS will also improve how Pilot Reports (PIREPS) and Notices to Airmen (NOTAMs) are collected and distributed. PIREPs are first-hand reports on weather conditions from pilots to air traffic controllers. Both provide vital information on real-time pilot conditions and improve situational awareness for controllers.

items.title: Where Each U.S. State Gets Its Tax Revenue From
items.summary: Article URL: https://www.visualcapitalist.com/where-each-states-tax-revenue-comes-from/ Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50393165 Points: 43 # Comments: 22
items.content:
From paychecks and purchases to homes and businesses, states rely on different combinations of taxes to fund public services.

This graphic breaks down combined state and local tax revenue across all 50 states using 2024 government finance data from the U.S. Census Bureau . The percentages show each category’s share of tax collections, excluding federal taxes and funding such as federal grants.

Property taxes are the largest revenue source in half of U.S. states, with particularly high shares in New Hampshire (64.3%), Alaska (42.4%), and Texas (41.1%). General sales and gross receipts taxes lead in 16 states, while individual income taxes top the list in seven.

The country’s largest states illustrate these differences. Individual income taxes dominate in California, while property taxes narrowly exceed general sales taxes in Florida and individual income taxes in New York.

Including local governments makes a substantial difference. In Texas, for example, property taxes are collected by local tax authorities and support services such as schools, roads, and fire protection, even though the state government itself levies no property tax.

These shares describe how governments raise money, rather than how much an individual household owes. A large property-tax share can reflect limited collections from other taxes as well as substantial property-tax revenue.

Florida collects no individual income tax revenue, with property and general sales taxes together supplying about three-quarters of state and local tax collections. In Texas, those two categories account for nearly 79%, highlighting both states’ reliance on property and consumption taxes.

New Hampshire takes that pattern further: property taxes generated 64.3% of tax revenue, the highest share nationwide. The state has no general sales tax and does not tax wages. Its small individual income tax share in 2024 reflects the interest and dividends tax, which was repealed effective in 2025.

Sales-related collections also extend beyond the checkout counter. General sales taxes include taxes on business gross receipts, while selective sales taxes apply to particular products or activities, such as fuel, tobacco, and utilities. This helps explain why a state’s revenue mix can look different from the taxes shoppers encounter directly.

Delaware’s largest revenue source is license taxes, accounting for roughly one-third of collections. This category includes corporate franchise licenses and related charges, giving it a much broader meaning than driver’s licenses or hunting permits.

That revenue source connects to Delaware’s position in corporate America. In 2024, the state was the legal home of more than two million business entities and about two-thirds of Fortune 500 companies. Incorporation generates public revenue from businesses whose operations extend far beyond Delaware’s borders.

North Dakota’s unusual mix reflects another economic advantage: natural resources. “Other taxes,” which include severance taxes on resource extraction, supplied 40.7% of collections. The state levies taxes on oil and gas production and oil extraction, linking part of its public finances to the value of energy produced within its borders.

To explore the role of property taxes worldwide, check out Revenues from property taxes are much higher in advanced economies on Voronoi.

Ranked: The World’s Most and Least Indebted Countries in 2026

Americans owe trillions in personal debt. See how much residents owe in every state, and why some carry nearly three times as much.

Americans owe trillions of dollars across mortgages, credit cards, auto loans, and student debt. But the amount people owe varies dramatically by location, with some of the highest balances concentrated in expensive housing markets.

This graphic maps average debt per person by state using Q4 2025 data from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York .

The figures cover residents with a credit report and combine major forms of household borrowing, making the map a measure of outstanding debt balances rather than financial distress or ability to repay.

Washington, D.C. leads the country in average personal debt, followed by Colorado and California. Colorado’s second-place ranking is particularly notable, putting it ahead of several states known for expensive housing, including California and Hawaii.

At the other end of the spectrum, West Virginia, Mississippi, and Arkansas have the lowest average debt balances.

Housing helps explain large differences in personal debt between states. In Colorado, mortgages account for 78% of average personal debt, compared with 55% in West Virginia.

Nationally, mortgages made up roughly 70% of America’s $18.8 trillion in household debt at the end of 2025. Because mortgages make up such a large share of debt, higher home prices can translate into larger average debt balances.

The amount Americans owe tells only part of the story. Monthly payments, interest rates, and household income ultimately determine how manageable that debt is.

For instance, Harvard’s 2026 housing report found that homeowners who moved in before 2020 had median first-mortgage payments roughly $800 lower per month than more recent movers, based on 2024 data.

For households facing higher housing costs and borrowing rates, those monthly payments can leave significantly less room for savings and everyday expenses.

The key distinction is between how much Americans owe and how difficult that debt is to repay. A homeowner with a large, low-interest mortgage may face less financial pressure than someone with a smaller balance carrying much higher interest costs.

To learn more about this topic, check out this graphic on the world’s most indebted households in 2026.

Norway leads the retirement rankings, but how does the U.S. compare? Explore the best countries to retire in 2026 and their living costs.

The world’s top countries for retirement combine strong pension systems, health care, and quality of life. However, living costs vary significantly, even among countries with similar retirement scores.

This graphic uses data from the 2026 Natixis Global Retirement Index , which evaluates countries across 18 indicators covering health, retirement finances, quality of life, and material well-being.

The table below compares retirement scores with estimated monthly living costs for one person, including rent for a one-bedroom apartment in the city center.

These estimates exclude personal health care expenses and taxes and do not account for differences in retirement income.

Germany ranks seventh for retirement, with estimated monthly living costs of $2,023, compared with $2,845 in the U.S. That $822 monthly gap adds up to roughly $98,600 over a decade, assuming costs remain unchanged.

Czechia and Iceland offer an even sharper contrast. Both score 75% on the retirement index, but estimated monthly costs are $1,678 in Czechia versus $4,118 in Iceland, a difference of more than $29,000 annually.

National pension and health care systems play a major role in retirement security.

Across OECD countries, mandatory pension systems are projected to replace an average of 63% of previous after-tax earnings. That ranges from more than 90% in the Netherlands and Portugal to 51% in the United States.

Health care costs also matter. In the U.S., a 65-year-old retiring in 2026 can expect to spend an estimated $185,500 on health care throughout retirement.

While stronger retirement systems can offset higher living costs, these rankings measure national retirement conditions, not how easy it is for foreigners to retire abroad. Visa requirements and access to local benefits can change the picture.

For more on retirement costs, see this graphic comparing the cost of retiring comfortably around the world.

items.title: Watch: Is it the end of the road for Tesla's Cybertruck?

items.content:
Tesla CEO Elon Musk has said production of the firm's Cybertruck is "winding down" in Texas, to focus on its self-driving Cybercab cars.

The model is only produced at Tesla's Austin base, and he did not clarify if manufacturing would be moved elsewhere or simply cease.

The Cybertruck has received a mixed response since its launch in 2023, with some praising its individuality and others simply labelling it ugly.

It has also suffered from disappointing sales, quality problems and recalls.

items.title: Ford Bronco Frostwarden: un veicolo da soccorso con 1.217 CV
items.summary: Ford svela al SEMA Show la Bronco Frostwarden da 1.217 CV: un esemplare unico da soccorso artico che porta al debutto il propulsore V8 Megazilla 2.0.
items.content:
Quando l'obiettivo è mostrare al mondo di cosa sia capace un motore, avvolgerlo dentro una carrozzeria qualunque non è mai un'opzione. Deve aver pensato questo la Casa dell'Ovale Blu quando ha deciso di svelare al SEMA Show 2026 di Las Vegas la Frostwarden, un esemplare unico su base Ford Bronco studiato per spingersi oltre ogni limite nei soccorsi ad altissima quota o tra i ghiacci artici. Un mostro di potenza che nasconde sotto il cofano il vero motivo di tanta esibizione. Il debutto ufficiale del nuovo propulsore 7.3 V8 Megazilla 2.0.A trasformare il Bronco in un mezzo d'assalto per i climi più ostili ci hanno pensato gli specialisti di Kincer Chassis, al lavoro sul progetto dallo scorso febbraio. L'obiettivo era chiarissimo fin dal primo giorno: creare un veicolo tanto appariscente quanto coerente con la sua ipotetica missione di salvataggio.[gallery ids="294236,294237,294240,294238,294239"]Esteticamente il colpo d'occhio è immediato. La livrea gioca sul contrasto tra il nero e il giallo tipico dei mezzi d'emergenza, un abbinamento che viene ripreso fedelmente anche all'interno dell'abitacolo (dove sul volante spicca la firma Megazilla). La dotazione da ricerca e soccorso non lascia spazio al superfluo. Davanti c'è un verricello pronto a tirare d'impaccio chiunque, sul tetto trova posto la ruota di scorta, mentre la sezione posteriore ospita un serbatoio ausiliario. Un sistema di illuminazione supplementare garantisce poi la massima visibilità anche nelle condizioni meteorologiche più scarse.Sotto la pelle, però, la preparazione si fa ancora più seria. Per superare ostacoli importanti e solchi profondi senza stressare eccessivamente le sole sospensioni, il team ha installato un sistema 74Weld con riduttori ai mozzi, soluzione furbissima per guadagnare centimetri preziosi di luce a terra. Il pacchetto meccanico si completa con pneumatici BFGoodrich da 42 pollici montati su cerchi beadlock personalizzati Weld da 18", ammortizzatori dedicati Bilstein e assali Dana 60. A gestire la "foga" del propulsore ci pensa invece una trasmissione automatica a dieci rapporti (la 10R100), presa in prestito dai giganti di casa, i pick-up Super Duty della serie F-Series.

Sotto il cofano un V8 da gara: cos'è il Megazilla 2.0

Tutto questo hardware serve in realtà da cornice al vero protagonista dello stand: il Megazilla 2.0. Rispetto al già poderoso V8 da 7,3 litri da cui deriva, i tecnici non si sono limitati ad imbullonare un compressore volumetrico Whipple Gen 6 da 3 litri. Il lavoro di ingegneria ha toccato il cuore dell'otto cilindri. Il monoblocco è stato rinforzato, l'albero a camme è stato riprogettato specificamente per la sovralimentazione e sono stati adottati pistoni aggiornati insieme a iniettori maggiorati.Il risultato finale parla da solo. Ben 1.217 cavalli di potenza e ben 1.356 Nm di coppia massima. C'è solo una piccola nota a margine da tenere in considerazione. Ovvero che Ford ha ottenuto questi rilevamenti (secondo lo standard SAE J607) alimentando il motore con carburante da competizione.

Un'idea da salone, un motore per il mercato

Se la Frostwarden ricoperta di neve rimarrà un puro esercizio di stile destinato a far sognare i visitatori del SEMA, Ford non ha alcuna intenzione di metterla in vendita, il discorso cambia radicalmente per il suo V8. Il Megazilla 2.0 entrerà presto a listino nel catalogo ufficiale Ford Racing Parts. Il prezzo non è stato ancora reso noto, ma le scuderie e i preparatori privati sanno già dove andare a bussare per le loro prossime follie su ruote.[drivek_widget brand_id="ford" model_id="explorer-electric"]

items.title: Borse: l'Europa scivola, Milano contiene le perdite, Wall Street apre contrastata
items.summary: Il clima resta nervoso, si guarda anche alla Bce. Giù il gas (-3%), calmo il petrolio
items.content:
Wall Street apre in altalena. Il Dow Jones perde lo 0,94% a 51.060,72 punti, il Nasdaq sale dell'1,22% a 24.625,96 punti mentre lo S&P 500 avanza dello 0,39% a 7.383,46 punti.

Restano forti vendite sui mercati azionari europei, che girano la boa di metà seduta sempre in ampio negativo. La Borsa peggiore è quella di Francoforte che cede il 2,2%, seguita da Londra in calo di due punti percentuali. Pesanti Parigi (-1,6%) e Amsterdam (-1,2%), con Madrid e Milano che provano a contenere i ribassi e segnano un calo attorno al punto percentuale.

Oscillano sempre attorno alla parità con una leggera intonazione positiva i future sull'avvio di Wall Street specie, sui titoli hi tech che hanno trainato lo scivolone di ieri. E quindi per l'indice Nasdaq.

Nel settore energia il gas conferma il suo calo e cede il 3% a 88 euro al Megawattora, mentre il petrolio si muove calmo sui 90 dollari dollari al barile. Senza grandi variazioni i titoli di Stato con lo spread Btp-Bund sui 109 euro, con l'euro che conferma il calo dello 0,4% a 1,117 contro il dollaro.

Con gli operatori che cominciano a guardare anche alle prossime scelte della Bce, in Piazza Affari tra i titoli a maggiore capitalizzazione Nexi accusa un calo del 3,8%, Generali di tre punti percentuali e il Banco Bpm del 2,7% dopo i conti resi noti ieri a mercati chiusi. Debole anche Unipol (-2,6%), mentre Mps è limata dello 0,7% dopo la trimestrale. Bene invece Technoprobe e Stm, che recuperano il 2,5% e il 2,6% dopo i pesanti ribassi della vigilia.

Anche i mercati azionari asiatici e dell'area del Pacifico chiudono tutti in calo sulla scia dello scivolone di Wall Street e dei i timori legati ai risultati delle elezioni statunitensi, che tra l'altro potrebbero rallentare gli investimenti nei data center dedicati all'intelligenza artificiale. I listini più pesanti sono Seul che ha ceduto il 6% netto e Tokyo in calo del 5,9%.

Negative anche le Borse cinesi , con Shenzhen che ha perso il 2,2% e Shanghai l'1,1%. In calo del'1,2% Hong Kong, mentre Sidney ha contenuto il ribasso di mezzo punto percentuale. Negativi i future sull'avvio dei listini europei, ancora incerti quelli su Wall street.

La Borsa di Tokyo termina la seduta con l'indice di riferimento sotto quota 60.000 punti per la prima volta in circa cinque mesi e mezzo.

Il listino di riferimento Nikkei segna una flessione del 5,96% a quota 57.434,77, con una perdita di 3.643 punti. Sul mercato valutario lo yen si rafforza sul dollaro a 157,80, e sull'euro a 176,70.

Ubuntu has CVE-2026-98432 marked as a 9.8, but yet it's coming up on a week with no update to fix it. It's still marked as "work in progress" (though at least now they've listed a mitigation):

https://ubuntu.com/security/CVE-2026-98432

I've had mitigations in place for a week, but this response is really shaking my confidence in Ubuntu. I'm just trying to understand what is going on with Ubuntu. Do they have too many kernels (that page is loooong), do they not have enough automation in the build/test pipeline, are their engineers overwhelmed?

We are moving into a world where there are going to be vastly more security issues; if you can't keep up now, where are you going to be in the next 6 months?

For a long time keeping on top of OS updates has been a huge part of keeping the attackers at bay. However, the world is changing.

items.title: Lippitt-Knoster in Practice (Field Notes for Managing Complex Projects)
items.summary: Article URL: https://sharedphysics.com/lippitt-knoster-in-practice-field-notes-for-managing-complex-projects/ Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50393089 Points: 22 # Comments: 1
items.content:
"Lippitt-Knoster" is one of those things where if you've worked with me during the last 10 years, you've likely heard me mention it. You might even be reading this because I needed somewhere to point you. In which case, Hi! 👋

The Lippitt-Knoster Model for Managing Complex Change was originally written to describe a way of navigating large organizational shifts, but I’ve found that it’s also useful as a diagnosis tool for any kind of large and long-running project. After all, every project is a "change" in a microcosm. You might not have a complex organizational change to manage every day, but everyone is involved in long-running projects of some size and shape in a company. So that’s what I use it for, and it is useful indeed.

The beauty of the model is that you don’t need an MBA or a special issue of the Harvard Business Review to explain it. It says that any complex project requires six components to succeed, and if one or another is missing, you’ll have some specific and corresponding failure.

It can be summed up in a simple chart but also rewards you with some deeper insights as you apply it:

Vision, consensus, and incentives are all Strategic Concerns . They involve abstract political work: ideas, relationships, people, and an understanding of the business. The action plan, skills, and resources are all Tactical Concerns . They are focused on the practical details of “how” something gets done. 1

One mistake I often see people make is to focus primarily on one concern or the other. For example, a product manager or corporate strategist might spend too much time focused on the strategic side of things without understanding if the team or company is able to execute. Consequently, their ability to build consensus will be negatively impacted by not knowing what is possible or probable. Line managers and software engineers typically make the opposite mistake. They focus too much on the ‘how’ instead of the ‘why’. They’ll prove that something is possible and how it can be done, without realizing that sometimes the team or business doesn't want to do the thing they’re proposing. Neither myopia ends in a successful project.

The order of the model components matters – they flow into each other – but can be managed in either direction. For example: you might start with a vision, build consensus, arrange the right incentives for everyone to act, create a plan, provide adequate resources and timeline to accomplish that plan, and make sure it is staffed with people who have the skills to execute on it. Easy peasy!

You could also navigate the components the other way, working through a series of questions: is something possible? Do skills exist to accomplish the thing? Do those skills (people) have excess capacity that can be allocated to this idea? Can it be done without budget? Can that group of people be small enough that they organically develop their own plans? And if so, are they incentivized to take on this kind of work outside their daily responsibilities? Does it need sign-off from anyone? If you’ve found confirmatory answers along the way, congratulations: you can carve out a secret R&D initiative within your team or your company. (This is also ' effectuation ' in practice.)

You can also read the model from the perspectives of both cause and effect. Reading it one way creates a checklist before kicking off any major work: “Here are the six prerequisites for success, are we all set?” (A causal, prescriptive reading – given starting parameters, what will be the end result?) Reading it backwards turns it into a troubleshooting tool. For example, if someone comes to you mid-project complaining that "We keep going in circles and the team is anxious! What can I do?" you might look at the model and respond, "Well of course! You don't have an action plan. Or maybe, it hasn't been adequately distributed and communicated and people feel that they lack the skills to accomplish something so big. Let's break it down into manageable pieces that we do have the skills for." It’s pretty quick to go between looking at the failure states and looking at the necessary components to diagnose what’s going on with a project. (A diagnostic reading, reasoning backwards.)

The model is a fantastic tool for making sense of things. But that leaves the hard work to start after you've made sense of things. How do you drive consensus? How do you align folks around a vision? How do you build up skills, or break down big projects into smaller pieces for which skills exist? How do you win resources, or align incentives?

Some of those answers are obvious, but most are not. Many of the answers are best understood as the manifestation of tacit expertise — a ‘feeling’ for the right move in any particular context, a form of expertise that comes from having been around the block a few times.

And like with most tacit expertise, you’ll find that there are no one-size-fits-all answers to any scenario, but there are plenty of good practices and useful observations.

The most common and important questions that come up after someone lays out a vision are “ Why should we do this? ” and permutations around the follow-up details. If you see those questions, that’s “confusion”, which is another way of saying you’ve presented a fantasy instead of a vision (or perhaps, the vision is missing entirely). That’s because many people confuse vision for having a colorful and inspiring imagination, making their picture too colorful, unrealistically grand, or too far off. 2

My experience is that you make more progress by simply providing adequate context and letting people derive their own vision. The art of context is giving people breadcrumbs to get from where you are today to where you want to be in the future, and giving them some good reasons to follow those breadcrumbs with you. There’s nothing more effective than a self-motivated team that thinks they’re the ones who came up with the idea, that they saw what things could be like. That’s vision.

Similarly, consensus is a straightforward concept, but strangely elusive in most organizations. Any organization beyond a certain age and size will typically have a 'minimally viable consensus' while practically being at odds with itself. Departments often turn into silos with their own internal logic for what should happen. Job security encourages teams to think about what’s best for them instead of for the company. And companies don’t do a great job tying “what’s best for the company” with “what’s best for the individuals within, or the communities around”, 3 which makes most employment mercenary: people naturally find a balance between what they’re paid and how much to care about the thing in question. (In that sense, incorporated businesses are kind of like democracy: a bad choice, but among the best of the options available for coordinating large groups of people to accomplish things.)

Recognizing that, one amateur mistake people make is trying to build consensus in a group setting. It just doesn't happen that way. You’re either going to have everyone nodding along and afraid to say their piece in front of everyone else, or you’re going to have one guy (and it’s usually a guy – sorry, my dudes) start pulling some “what about”-ism and dragging the conversation into a black hole of details that you never intended to argue about but find yourself frustratingly debating anyway.

In Japanese business culture there is a concept called “nemawashi”, which translates roughly to “tending to the roots” or “laying the groundwork”. It’s a good analogy because the practice of creating consensus requires a lot of political skill, footwork, trust-building, and private conversation. It means giving people space to tell you everything that’s wrong with your idea, finding ways to address those concerns, and making sure everyone is aligned before the alignment actually happens. The group meeting when everyone signs off in agreement should be the result of careful stage management — you should know and have already addressed everyone’s concerns, including second-order effects of how addressing one person’s issues will impact others.

That said, you might not be able to get to consensus. Perhaps your boss wants the “thing” to happen but there’s another department that’s actively against it. Maybe you're encroaching on their turf, or it will reduce their capacity in some zero-sum resource bucket. Maybe they just have a different perspective on the world and the approaches the business should take. Maybe you've wandered into a long-running feud and this project is just one of many different battles being waged. Who knows, people can be both petty and complicated!

If you can't get their buy-in, they will sabotage it in all sorts of creative ways. Because sabotage and resistance are close cousins and are political (in the sense of not being open conflict), monographs on activism and subterfuge can be read as useful primers. Consider James C. Scott's Weapons of the Weak and the OSS's Simple Sabotage Field Manual for what kinds of foot dragging, malicious compliance, noncompliance, evasion, sowing confusion, slander, useless meetings, arbitrary hurdles, revisiting decisions, and moving goalposts to expect.

items.title: Tanzanian opposition leader found guilty of inciting unrest but acquitted of treason
items.summary: The 58-year-old, who has been detained since April last year, says the charges are politically motivated.
items.content:
Tanzania's main opposition leader, Tundu Lissu, has been found guilty of inciting unrest and sentenced to four years in jail, in a case that has raised concerns about political freedom in the East African country.

A panel of three judges at the High Court in Dar es Salaam acquitted him of the more serious offence of treason, saying prosecutors had failed to prove a key element of that charge.

But they said the 58-year-old, who has been detained since April last year, had encouraged his supporters to disrupt the disputed 2025 general election.

Lissu, who leads the opposition Chadema party, has denied the charges, describing the prosecution as politically motivated.

The court said his campaign slogan "No Reforms, No Election" was sufficient for him to be convicted of the charge of incitement.

"By uttering those words with the intention of disseminating them to the public, the accused incited the public to disrupt the 2025 elections," the court ruled.

Lissu said he had only been charged with treason, not incitement.

"The offence of incitement is one that you, honourable judges, have manufactured. You have created an offence that did not exist, and you have done so on political directives," Lissu told the court.

He added that he would like to apply for bail as this was possible for incitement, unlike treason.

He has leave to appeal at the Court of Appeal - the country's highest court.

But if the four-year sentence is upheld, it would rule him out of the next elections, due in 2030.

Treason is among Tanzania's most serious offences and can carry the death penalty.

Human rights group Amnesty International described his conviction as a "travesty of justice".

"Tundu Lissu should never have been arrested, let alone prosecuted and convicted," said its regional director for East and Southern Africa, Tigere Chagutah:

President Samia Suluhu Hassan won the October 2025 election with 98% of the vote - a result the opposition dismissed the result as a "mockery" of democracy as her two main challengers, including Lissu, were excluded.

Her government has repeatedly denied targeting its opponents.

Demands for post-poll justice as Tanzania accused of weaponising counterterrorism laws

WATCH: Tundu Lissu: A Fight Too Far? on BBC Africa Eye's YouTube channel

The Chadema leader was arrested six months before the poll, shortly after launching a campaign demanding changes to the electoral system under the slogan "No Reforms, No Election".

Prosecutors accused him of making statements intended to incite the public to disrupt the election and threaten the government.

They argued that his remarks, which were also circulated online, amounted to treason.

But Lissu, a lawyer who represented himself during the trial, maintained that his comments were part of a legitimate political campaign for constitutional and electoral reform.

He argued that prosecutors had taken his statements out of context and failed to prove that he had committed any crime.

Electoral commissioners should be independently appointed (not by the president)

Police should allow all parties to campaign free of intimidation

Government-appointed district chiefs should no longer act as returning officers

Party agents should be able to observe counting without harassment

It should be possible to challenge presidential election results in court.

During his time in remand custody at Dar es Salaam's Ukonga Prison, Lissu went on hunger strike twice for brief periods when he said he was not allowed access to his lawyers or relatives. He also complained that guards listened to what should have been private consultations his lawyers.

These allegations have been denied by the prison authorities.

His case has attracted international attention, with rights groups expressing concern about the treatment of opposition politicians and the shrinking space for political dissent in Tanzania.

Last year's election was followed by widespread protests and a violent security crackdown that left at least 500 people dead, according to an official inquiry.

Opposition groups have said the death toll was much higher and demanded an independent investigation.

The government has defended its handling of the unrest and rejected accusations of widespread political repression.

Samia, 66, has insisted the election was fair and transparent and blamed foreigners for the unrest, saying it was part of a plot to overthrow her. She has set up another commission to inquiry to identify those behind the violence.

Lissu has long been one of Tanzania's most outspoken critics of the ruling Chama Cha Mapinduzi (CCM) party, which, along with its predecessor Tanu, has dominated the country's politics since independence.

He first became an MP in 2010, representing a constituency near his birth place in Singida, 320km (200 miles) north-west of the capital, Dodoma.

In September 2017, the Chadema politician narrowly survived an assassination attempt when gunmen sprayed his vehicle with bullets outside his home in Dodoma.

He was shot multiple times and underwent extensive medical treatment abroad.

The attack, whose perpetrators have never been brought to justice, forced him to spend years in exile.

He returned to contest the 2020 presidential election against the late President John Magufuli, but lost in a vote that the opposition alleged was marred by widespread irregularities.

Lissu subsequently returned to exile before coming back to Tanzania in 2023, following President Samia's decision to lift a ban on opposition political rallies.

His return was initially seen as a sign of renewed political openness after years of restrictions under Magufuli, who died in office in 2021.

But relations between the government and the opposition deteriorated as the country approached the 2025 election.

Lissu became Chadema's national chairman in January 2025 and intensified his demands for electoral reforms.

His conviction is likely to deepen concerns about the state of democracy in Tanzania.

Last week, Amnesty accused the government of continuing its crackdown following the election and "weaponising counterterrorism laws to silence critics and instil fear".

Correction: An initial version of this story said Lissu had been convicted of inciting treason. We have corrected this to incitement.

items.title: GrapheneOS: cos'è, perché è diverso da Android e come si installa
items.summary: GrapheneOS esce per la prima volta dall'ecosistema Pixel e debutta su Motorola. Ma di cosa si tratta?
items.content:
GrapheneOS viene rilasciato nel 2019 come sistema operativo mobile focalizzato su privacy e sicurezza. Basato su Android AOSP e storicamente legato ai Google Pixel, il progetto si sta estendendo grazie alla collaborazione siglata al MWC con Motorola, aprendo alla compatibilità anche con i primi smartphone della Casa Alata. "L'obiettivo iniziale della nostra partnership con Motorola è un dispositivo tradizionale non pieghevole", avevano rivelato gli sviluppatori ad agosto. E così è effettivamente stato: in attesa dei RAZR, il primo smartphone Motorola con supporto nativo all'OS è il nuovo Signature 27 appena presentato.

Più che di un sistema operativo in senso stretto bisognerebbe parlare di un vero e proprio ecosistema, almeno in prospettiva: i lavori di sviluppo sono tuttora in corso con l'obiettivo di estendere gli standard di sicurezza e protezione dei dati anche alle singole applicazioni.

items.title: Kenyan doomsday cult leader given life sentence for murdering 191 people
items.summary: Paul Mackenzie ordered his followers to starve their children to death in a forest so they could "meet Jesus".
items.content:
A Kenyan court has sentenced the leader of a doomsday cult, Paul Mackenzie, to 200 years in prison for murdering 191 people, all but one of them children.

Alongside 28 others, Mackenzie was found guilty of the murders for instructing members of his cult to starve their children to death so they could "meet Jesus".

Justice Diana Mochache said Mackenzie bore the "primary criminal culpability" for ordering his followers to fast to death, in one of the world's deadliest episodes of cult activity.

"The sentence is appropriate and just, to send an unmistakable message that such atrocities warrant the maximum penalties allowed by law," the judge added.

The self-styled pastor was arrested in 2023 after the discovery of more than 400 bodies in shallow graves in Shakahola forest near the Kenyan coast. The sprawling investigation into the cases shocked Kenya and drew international attention.

The court sentenced Mackenzie to 100 years in prison for homicide and another 100 years for offences related to starvation.

The sentences within each category will run concurrently, but the two sets will run consecutively, bringing his total prison term to 200 years.

Mackenzie also faces separate manslaughter and terrorism charges, which he denies.

Prosecutors had sought the death penalty, arguing that the scale and circumstances of the killings warranted the harshest punishment.

However, Justice Mochache declined to impose the death penalty, despite ruling that the case met the threshold for its consideration.

"Nevertheless, the court declines the invitation to impose the death penalty on any of the victims," she said, adding that capital punishment would eliminate any prospect of rehabilitation and disengagement. The death sentence has not been carried out in Kenya since 1987.

Mackenzie was tried alongside 28 accomplices, including guards who enforced his fasting orders and gravediggers who helped conceal the victims' bodies in mass graves.

Justice Mochache described the killings as "cold and calculated", saying the perpetrators had shown no remorse and had even declared their willingness to fast to death themselves.

Before the hearing began on Friday morning, Francis Wanje, who lost eight relatives including two grandchildren in Shakahola forest, told the BBC's Newsday programme that he was "hoping for... a sentence which will match his [Mackenzie's] deeds in the forest".

Mackenzie and the co-accused had asked for leniency from the court.

Before their conviction on 19 October, they had all pleaded not guilty and repeatedly insisted that nobody was forced to die.

Mackenzie's followers believed he was "Jesus's mouthpiece", Justice Mochache said as she delivered her eight-hour judgement last month.

Those who opposed Mackenzie's teachings were beaten to death.

One of his co-accused said he had told his followers that anyone who "resisted the directive to fast must be forced to go to heaven through kicks and blows".

Burials inside the forest where the cult was based were called "weddings" and those who died "were celebrated as having wedded with Jesus" the judge said.

The judge found that the deaths arose from an organised system, including religious teachings and directives that compelled followers to follow the deadly fasting.

Post-mortem results showed the cause of deaths to be starvation for most victims, while others died from suffocation, strangulation or head injuries.

The cause of death could not be determined for some, with their bodies having decomposed, while others died soon after their rescue as they were so emaciated.

The Shakahola deaths have shone a spotlight on the lack of oversight of rogue religious activities and how they could have carried on for so long.

The gravity of the case prompted President William Ruto to set up a commission of inquiry, although this was later declared unconstitutional.

Investigations by the state-funded Kenya National Commission on Human Rights (KNCHR) revealed that local administration and law enforcement officials had repeatedly turned a blind eye to the cult's activities.

"We expected at that time the police would take action immediately to go and rescue the other members there, but it didn't happen," said Wanje, who reported the case to the police in March 2023.

Wanje said a relative of his in the police force and a former cult participant had managed to save his grandson at the time. The child told the police what had happened and showed them the grave of his siblings.

"It was [supposed to be] his last day.. they [would have killed] my grandson."

The cult leader had previously been arrested and later released for lack of evidence.

Mackenzie established Good News International Ministries in 2003.

Over the next 16 years, the church grew in popularity, drawing thousands of followers in its branches across Kenya.

The church ran a television station called Times TV which would broadcast his sermons from his church in Malindi.

His End Days sermons included conspiracy theories that described education as "evil", healthcare as "against the doctrine" and digital identity cards as "the mark of the devil".

The main church shut down in 2019 and Mackenzie moved to Shakahola forest, encouraging his devotees to follow him.

While the conclusion of the murder cases may bring a sense of justice for the victims and their families, the convictions only account for 191 victims, while more than 400 bodies were exhumed from the forest.

items.summary: Ho alcune domande sulla pulizia dei sex toys. Bastano acqua e sapone o dobbiamo metterli in lavastoviglie? Leggi
items.content:
Avvertenza . Il linguaggio di questa rubrica è diretto ed esplicito.

Gli studi che parlano del sesso come di qualcosa che può avere effetti positivi sulla salute – per esempio, quelli che dicono che i rapporti regolari riducano i problemi alla prostata – a quale tipo di sesso si riferiscono? Anale? Orale? Masturbazione? La persona deve raggiungere l’orgasmo?

items.summary: Amazon permette di interagire con Alexa for Shopping tramite messaggi per cercare prodotti, ricevere consigli ed effettuare acquisti.
items.content:
Amazon punta molto sulle abilità del proprio assistente AI legate allo shopping. Non poteva essere altrimenti, considerando la sua leadership tra gli e-commerce. E pochi giorni dopo aver presentato oltre 100 nuove funzionalità a tema, oggi annuncia l'arrivo di quella che permette di fare acquisti scambiando messaggi con l'intelligenza artificiale, senza dover passare dall'app dedicata. La modalità di interazione è quella tipica di una chat in cui si descrive il prodotto che si sta cercando, eventualmente caricandone un'immagine, per ricevere in risposta consigli e procedere poi all'ordine.

SCRIVI AD ALEXA FOR SHOPPING PER FARE LA SPESA

È un'evoluzione della tecnologia Alexa for Shopping introdotta nel mese di maggio negli Stati Uniti. Anche in questo caso il debutto è previsto inizialmente oltreoceano, a partire da oggi ed entro le prossime settimane, con un rollout graduale che coinvolge gli utenti invitandoli a provare la novità attraverso un SMS.

Gli screenshot allegati qui mostrano in modo molto chiaro come funziona. Lo scambio può avvenire con un linguaggio naturale, ad esempio chiedendo aiuto per comprare un regalo e descrivendo i gusti personali di chi lo riceverà. L'AI replicherà con dei consigli mirati, proponendo le varianti disponibili e ricordando le preferenze per le conversazioni future.
